newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: RUGBY UNION-SOUTH AFRICA LINE UP SAME TEAM AGAINST ARGENTINA.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-SOUTH AFRICA LINE UP SAME TEAM AGAINST ARGENTINA.

text.p: South Africa, injury-free and full of confidence after their 46-15 first test win, line up an unchanged team against the Argentine Pumas in the second test on Saturday.
The Pumas will be without Gonzalo Camardon, injured in scoring a try last Saturday. Eduardo Simone, who replaced him in that match at number 13, will start in that position.

Two other stalwarts are back after injury -- fullback Ezequiel Jurado and Diego Albanese, who replace Tomas Solari, a promising player who still needs experience, and Octavio Bertolucci at numbers 14 and 15.

These changes may strengthen the Pumas team slightly but captain Lisandro Arbizu says they must avoid the elementary mistakes which brought about their downfall last weekend, after they had gone ahead 8-3 in the first half.
"We will just have to be very careful not to make any mistakes this time, " Arbizu said. "I am confident we can do better but we will have to concentrate more".

But perhaps it is also a question of stamina. Hooker Federico Mendez, who has just finished a season playing in South Africa for Natal, said: "The South Africans train for some 26 hours a week and the Pumas may train for about eight hours if they can make it."

Argentina - Ezequiel Jurado, Diego Albanese, Eduardo Simone, Lisandro Arbizu, Facundo Soler, Jose Luis Cilley, Nicolas Fernandez Miranda, Pablo Camerlinckx, Raul Perez, Rolando Martin, German Llanes, Pedro Sporleder, Omar Hasan, Federico Mendez, Roberto Grau.

South Africa - Andre Joubert, Franco Smith, Japie Mulder, Hennie le Roux, Jacques Olivier, Henry Honiball, Joost van der Westhuizen, Gary Teichmann, Andre Venter, Ruben Kruger, Mark Andrews, Kobus Wiese, Adrian Garvey, James Dalton, Dawie Theron.
